blocks.name: Acids, Bases & Protons
blocks.definition:
understand acids and bases in terms of proton transfer
understand that an acid is a proton donor and a base is a proton acceptor

blocks.md:
- The earlier definition of an acid and a base can be extended
- In terms of proton transfer, we can further define each substance in how they interact with protons

- Acids are **proton donors **as they ionize in solution producing protons, H<sup>+</sup> ions
- These H<sup>+</sup> ions make the aqueous solution acidic
- **Example: **hydrochloric acid

- Bases (alkalis) are** proton acceptors** as they ionize in solution producing OH<sup>-</sup> ions which can accept protons
- These OH<sup>-</sup> ions make the aqueous solution alkaline
- **Example: **sodium hydroxide
